gloss: new fiscal year; new academic year

definitions.gloss: new fiscal year; new academic year
definitions.explanation: The beginning of a new fiscal or academic year. In Japan, both the fiscal year and academic year start in April, making this a significant transition point for businesses, schools, and government.

examples.japanese: {新年度|しんねんど}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The new fiscal year has begun.

examples.japanese: {新年度|しんねんど}の{予算|よさん}を{組|く}む{時期|じき}だ。
examples.english: It's time to draw up the budget for the new fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {新年度|しんねんど}に{向|む}けて、{人事異動|じんじいどう}の{発表|はっぴょう}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Personnel transfers were announced ahead of the new fiscal year.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, the fiscal year ({会計年度|かいけいねんど}) and the academic year ({学年度|がくねんど}) both begin in April. The weeks surrounding April 1st are a major transition period: new employees start work, students begin new school years, and government budgets take effect.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新年度|しんねんど}の{予算|よさん} (new fiscal year budget)
- {新年度|しんねんど}に{向|む}けて (in preparation for the new year)
- {新年度|しんねんど}から (starting from the new year)

RELATED WORDS:
- {年度|ねんど} (fiscal/academic year)
- {年度末|ねんどまつ} (end of the fiscal year — March)
- {新学期|しんがっき} (new school term)
